system.name: HybridMesh
system.one_liner: a hardware-software hybrid system that offloads service-mesh ingress packet processing from the host OS to a programmable SmartNIC

components.name: AP detector
components.role: the HM NIC stack module that runs access-point matching, TLS decryption, and AP-aware RSS

components.name: (1) AP matching
components.role: inspects packet headers to identify the shared access point (AP) grouping related services

components.name: Access point i
components.role: an access point identifier the AP detector matches against

components.name: (2) TLS decryption
components.role: decrypts TLS payloads via kTLS offload using secrets installed during the handshake so dispatchers can analyze them

components.name: (3) AP-aware RSS
components.role: dynamically assigns packets from a given AP to a designated set of cores while preserving per-connection affinity

components.name: Queue i
components.role: a per-core receive queue that packets from a given AP's core set are steered to

components.name: Traffic dispatcher A (core 1)
components.role: per-core dispatcher that receives an AP's packets from its RSS queue and determines their destination service

components.name: (4) Service matching
components.role: extracts policy-defined fields from the packet and selects a destination service and endpoint pod

components.name: Service a
components.role: one of several services an AP's traffic can be dispatched to

components.name: Pod A
components.role: an endpoint pod candidate for a matched service

components.name: (5) Metadata embedding
components.role: writes the selected service, subset, and policy identifiers into the packet's Destination MAC field as metadata

components.name: L2 Packet
components.role: the outgoing packet shown with its embedded metadata field

components.name: HM NIC stack
components.role: overall SmartNIC-resident module whose internal workflow this figure details

flows.what: packets matched to an access point (AP) proceed to have their TLS payloads decrypted
decrypted packets, with AP information attached, assigned to a traffic dispatcher
packets from a per-core RSS queue delivered to the corresponding traffic dispatcher
identified service/subset/policy IDs passed along for embedding
endpoint pod selected, optionally from a header-defined subset (e.g., version=v1 to subset_a)
6-byte metadata (service, subset, policy) inserted into the packet's Destination MAC field

content.key_idea: The HM NIC stack processes each packet through five in-order steps on the SmartNIC — access-point matching, TLS decryption, AP-aware RSS, service matching, and metadata embedding — so that by the time a packet reaches the host it already carries its routing decision as packet metadata.
content.reading_order: Left to right through the AP detector's three sub-stages (1-3), then into a per-core traffic dispatcher for service matching (4) and metadata embedding (5).

summary: Figure 4 details the five-step internal workflow of HybridMesh's HM NIC stack, all running on the SmartNIC before any packet reaches the host. Inside the AP detector, incoming packets are first matched to a shared access point (step 1), have any TLS payload decrypted via kTLS offload (step 2), and are steered to a per-core queue by AP-aware receiver-side scaling that preserves connection affinity (step 3). A per-core Traffic dispatcher then extracts policy-defined fields to match the packet to a destination service and endpoint pod, optionally narrowing to a header-selected subset such as subset_a (step 4), and finally embeds the chosen service/subset/policy identifiers as 6-byte metadata in the packet's Destination MAC field before it is handed to the node's kernel (step 5). A worked example with services a-d and pods A-D, plus bottom call-outs naming the network-identifier and service-signature fields each stage consumes, makes the abstract pipeline concrete.
summary_zh: 图4展示HM NIC栈内部五步流水线：接入点匹配、TLS解密、AP感知RSS分发、服务匹配（含按请求头分子集选择Pod）、元数据嵌入（将服务/子集/策略ID写入L2包的目的MAC字段），全部在SmartNIC上完成后再交给主机内核。
